author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Authorities are investigating a homicide in Salem after a 42-year-old woman was found dead inside a Cabot Street residence during a well-being check Wednesday morning.

Boston 25 News reported that Salem police responded at about 11:30 a.m. and discovered the woman’s body. Officials had not released her name in the initial report. The Essex County District Attorney’s Office and Salem police are handling the investigation, and no additional circumstances surrounding the death were immediately disclosed.

A 50-year-old Salem man was arrested later in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, on a warrant connected to the case. He was expected to appear first in New Hampshire as a fugitive from justice before being returned to Massachusetts. Prosecutors said he would then be arraigned in Salem District Court on a murder charge.

The charge is an allegation, and the defendant is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in court. Authorities said they expected to release more information Thursday. The arrest also adds a cross-state legal step before the Massachusetts case can proceed, with New Hampshire authorities responsible for the initial fugitive proceeding and transfer process.
dek: A 50-year-old Salem man was taken into custody in New Hampshire after police found a 42-year-old woman dead during a well-being check on Cabot Street.
headline: Salem homicide suspect arrested in Portsmouth after woman found dead
